data.one_liner: Show native alert dialogs on iOS and Toast messages on Android.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that displays native iOS alert dialogs and Android Toast messages using a single line of code. It provides an optional shortDuration parameter for Android toasts.
use_when: You need to show quick toast messages on Android
You need to show native alert dialogs on iOS
You want a simple one-line API for platform-specific feedback
avoid_when: You need a unified UI across both iOS and Android platforms
You need complex custom widgets or styling for your alerts
strengths: Uses native components for each platform (iOS alerts, Android toasts)
weaknesses: Platform behavior differs fundamentally (dialogs vs toasts)

alternatives.name: fluttertoast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically want toast messages across platforms instead of platform-split alerts.

alternatives.name: toastification
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want customizable, in-app toast notifications with rich UI.
